notes.title: Release Date Set!
notes.notes:
Greetings! 👋

Ready to aim for gun business success? Because we are launching next month! 🔥

Gun Center Simulator is launching on July 21, 2025! 💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618200/Gun_Center_Simulator/

[previewyoutube=ggfPMArzfHo;full][/previewyoutube]
Step into the shoes of a passionate collector and entrepreneur as you build, manage, and expand your very own gun center from the ground up. 🏬

Sell a vast selection of firearms - from classic pistols to the latest high-tech weaponry. Organize your inventory with care, attract a wide range of customers - hobbyists, hunters, security pros, and collectors - and watch as your gun business grows. 🔫

But the FUN part is... 👀
Not only can you sell guns - you can test them too on the SHOOTING RANGE! 🎯 The fully equipped shooting range lets you try out any firearm from your collection. Whether you’re testing a sniper rifle or a handgun, the range is the ultimate playground. 😎

So, don’t Miss the Launch! 🫵 Add Gun Center Simulator to your Steam Wishlist today and be the first to experience the excitement of running your own gun shop and shooting range! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594234/b0f1e129b77decbffcfb32a2aeccf8adef3fa211.gif

Join us on July 21, 2025, and see if you have what it takes to become the top gun dealer in town. 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594234/fe8d51452bef96ab16482d2693796c0ef9338f31.png

See you at the grand opening ✅
